privileged_info_for_vlm: The KSFO ILS RWY 28R approach uses frequency 111.7. ARCHI is an Initial Approach Fix and DUMBA is the Final Approach Fix. While the setup script might mention identifier 'I-SFO', the verified identifier for 111.7 at KSFO 28R is actually 'I-GWQ'; however, the task only requires the frequency '111.7' to be boxed. Ensure altitudes used in labels match the content of '~/Desktop/iap_data.txt'.
